capabilities: Detect files that are 0 bytes or contain only spaces and line breaks
Find unused attachments in jpg, jpeg, png, gif, svg and pdf formats
Delete found files via ribbon command
Choose between system trash, Obsidian .trash folder, or permanent deletion
extras: Known issue: attachments used inside Admonition code blocks are not recognized as used. Usage is a single ribbon-icon click; deletion options are configured in settings.
problem: Vaults accumulate empty files and orphaned attachments that Obsidian has no built-in way to bulk-remove.
summary: Cleanup utility that deletes empty (0-byte or whitespace-only) files and attachments no note references.
